tagline: STRATEGIC FINANCE  ·  REVENUE MIX & RESERVES  ·  BOARD PARTNERSHIP  ·  PARKS & PUBLIC SPACE
profile: Hands-on finance executive for mission-driven organizations with mixed public, philanthropic, and earned revenue. Shapes long-term financial strategy, including revenue mix, reserves, and investment and funding strategy, through scenario modeling; leads budgeting, cash flow, audit readiness, and internal controls; and works closely with Presidents and Boards of Trustees. Built earned-revenue social enterprises, structured $10M+ in government and institutional contracts, and reversed a $1M deficit into a 13% surplus. Experienced running finance with a lean team while modernizing systems and reporting.

bullets.text: Spearhead liquidity and working-capital strategy, including covenant monitoring, short-term financing analysis, and stress testing; support capital allocation through scenario modeling.
Lead financial planning, budgeting, treasury, liquidity management, and cash-flow forecasting for client organizations across nonprofit, private, education, and public-sector settings.
Direct audit readiness and external audit processes; ensure GAAP and Uniform Guidance compliance; design internal controls and fund-accounting frameworks.
Execute financial turnarounds, forensic accounting, historical clean-up, and audit remediation for organizations with reporting deficiencies.
Identified and recovered $1.5M+ in tax savings through detailed financial analysis and correction of reporting deficiencies.
Structured the financial framework for a NYPA Clean Energy Workforce Program, aligning public funding, compliance, and performance metrics.

jobs.title: Vice President, Business Development & Social Ventures

bullets.text: Developed revenue-generating social ventures that combined financial sustainability with mission outcomes.
Negotiated and structured $10M+ in new government, institutional, and corporate contracts.

Partnered with the CEO and Board on long-range planning, risk management, and organizational growth strategy.
Held full P&L accountability for an $8M portfolio within a $50M+ nonprofit; led financial and operational oversight of a 140-person, multi-program division.
Directed financial controls, billing, and compliance for NYCHA and NYC Department of Homeless Services contracts.
Renegotiated vendor and logistics agreements, reducing costs 35% and improving margins.
Implemented a redesigned ERP-based warehouse management system, improving processing efficiency 60% and data visibility.
